gloss: packing tape; duct tape; cloth tape

definitions.gloss: packing tape; duct tape; cloth tape
definitions.explanation: Wide, strong adhesive tape used for sealing cardboard boxes, bundling items, and general repairs. A wasei-eigo coinage from "gum" + "tape"; refers mainly to paper-backed kraft tape and cloth-backed duct tape, not the narrow transparent {セロハンテープ|せろはんてーぷ}.

examples.japanese: ガムテープで{箱|はこ}を{封|ふう}した。
examples.english: I sealed the box with packing tape.

examples.japanese: ガムテープが{足|た}りなくなったので{買|か}いに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I ran out of packing tape, so I went to buy more.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しの{荷造|にづく}りには{布|ぬの}ガムテープのほうが{丈夫|じょうぶ}で{使|つか}いやすい。
examples.english: For packing when moving house, cloth packing tape is sturdier and easier to use.

notes:
Wasei-eigo from English "gum" + "tape." Refers to wide, sturdy adhesive tape (typically 50 mm), in contrast to the narrow transparent tape called {セロハンテープ|せろはんてーぷ} or just セロテープ.

COMMON TYPES:
- {紙|かみ}ガムテープ: paper-backed kraft tape (cheap, brown)
- {布|ぬの}ガムテープ: cloth-backed duct tape (stronger, easier to tear by hand)
- {透明|とうめい}ガムテープ: transparent packing tape (OPP tape)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ガムテープで{封|ふう}する: to seal with packing tape
- ガムテープを{貼|は}る: to apply packing tape
- ガムテープを{剥|は}がす: to peel off packing tape
